symptom: `brain capture --partly-meets a1b2c3:"web only, no mobile"` fails with '" no mobile" is not a requirement id' (and the same for --changes, and --accepts with a reason containing a comma)
cause: The flags were declared StringSlice, which splits each value on commas, so a reason with a comma became a second id
insight: A repeatable flag whose value is free text must be a StringArray; StringSlice is for lists of identifiers. Found by an end-to-end run with a natural-language reason, which no unit test of the verdict helpers could see because they take the already-split value
